text:
leah: Heads-up — Orchid (ap-northeast3) partner wants to list a dedicated SKU in the marketplace and reserve 6x H100s. target launch 2026-01-10. Can we do quota + KMS integration?

omar: quick check: orchids' regional demand looks promising. need infra runbook updated for H100 capacity. tagging @ravi for quota request.

ravi: infra snapshot: ap-northeast3 pools at 64%. 6x H100 can be served but provider quota request required. ETA usually 4-6 business days. i'll open the ticket today.

marta: comms note: partner wants co-marketing and a technical install note. i need SKU id, pricing, and a short integration checklist.

orchid-poc: we'll provide a partner-managed KMS with external-wrapped keys. sample policy attached in playbook. also we can spin a test tenant for integration next week.

legal-bot: reminder: if partner manages keys + holds consumer data, legal needs the security questionnaire and residency confirmation. any HSM involvement requires an addendum.

leah: action items: ravi submit quota ticket, marta to draft SKU + comms, legal to review KMS sample. orch id: rw-orchid-6h100-v1.

deploy-bot: playbook created /playbooks/partnerships/1755001234-orchid-marketplace-onboard.md (owners: ravi,marta,leah,legal-bot).

ravi: quota ticket Q-50321 opened. provider ETA 5 business days. linked in playbook.

marta: pricing question — omar can you DM me estimated hourly cost so we can price the SKU?

omar: sure, sending numbers to #partners-costs. recommend ~15% margin to start.

legal-bot: reviewed KMS policy. asked partner to scope ARNs to provisioned keys and enable admin MFA. posted redline to playbook.

orchid-poc: test tenant creds arriving Mon EOD; we'll expose restricted KMS wrap endpoint for smoke tests.

leah: tentative timeline: dry-run 2026-01-06, partner smoke 2026-01-07, soft launch 2026-01-10, public announce 2026-01-13. next sync Tue 10:00 PT.

ravi: quota approved at 1755001500, allocating 6x H100. playbook updated.

leah: great — proceeding with dry-run schedule. thanks team :)
